name: feature.profiles.nodes
description: Profiles feature node pack — reads over ctx.features.profiles (ADR 0172 / ADR 0624): list/get the tenant's profiles (read-only projections) so a workflow can branch or personalize on profile data. get takes { userId } and answers { profile, found } (an empty id is a typed validation_error failure; a real-id miss is found:false). Tenant-guarded; role:action (recorded).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Profiles: List
nodes.description: Lists the tenant's profiles over ctx.features.profiles.listProfiles. Output: { profiles }.

nodes.label: Profiles: Get
nodes.description: Reads one member's profile over ctx.features.profiles.getProfile. Inputs: { userId } (the opaque user:<id> in the run's tenant). Output: { profile|null, found }. An empty/absent userId is a typed validation_error node FAILURE (never success-with-null); a real id not in the tenant is { profile: null, found: false } so a chain branches on { falsy found }.
